$comment: Laminart (recycled and natural veneers, a Wilsonart brand) runs Magento 2 on laminart.com, with product images served from the Wilsonart media host. Product URLs are /<product-slug>-<number> (for example /coal-706; from sitemap.xml). Samples and quotes are the only purchase path, so there is no price in the markup (the product-info-price block holds only the 'Available Product Types' selector), and no stock signal, so price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. Title is the product-info-main name, image is the main gallery image, description is the Description section, and the specs are the 'More Information' attribute table (th/td pairs; 2 on the sample: Translucent, Vertical use only). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image, description and 2 specs; browser: the same, slower; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: the same fields plus a stock status not in the page (out_of_stock) at 958+440 tokens, which is not used; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: the same data at no cost. Checked against saved (curl) Coal Buffalo 706 Recycled Leather Veneers page on 2026-11-19.
